description.value: Vegan Shoku is a fully plant-based Japanese restaurant on West 41st Avenue in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, offering an extensive menu of sushi rolls, ramen, udon, donburi, and creative vegan interpretations of Japanese seafood dishes. Every item on the menu is vegan, making it a reliable stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions. The restaurant offers dine-in and takeout, with online ordering available through their POS portal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is an online ordering portal (swypepos.com) for Vegan Shoku, confirming the address (2260 W. 41st Ave., Vancouver) and phone (604-566-6556) match OSM, and shows 'OPEN' with an active full menu. OSM tags diet:vegan=only and takeaway=yes are corroborated by the entirely plant-based menu and the takeout ordering interface. No evidence in OSM or website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi (OSM internet_access=wlan tag noted but not website-confirmed), or other cyclist-specific amenities.
